newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 12.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Yemen seeks to lure foreign investments in construction.
- Car sales in Morocco rise in 1996 with locally-produced vehicles leading the market.
- Arab agency urges Arab states to provide 2.5 million jobs a year to wipe out unemployment.
- Sudanese foreign minister says Sudan has accepted an initiative by the United Arab Emirates to mediate an end to the conflict in his country.
- Kuwait's real estate market witnesses boom due to soft loans and higher returns.
- Arab chambers of commerce, industry and agriculture to meet in Cairo later this month.
